featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt note from a happy Billabong parent – Malad branch

The first day at Billabong was nothing short of reassuring. From the moment we stepped in, there was a sense of warmth and belonging. The transition was handled so smoothly – every effort was made to ensure the children felt safe, seen, and supported. My daughter came home beaming with joy and couldn’t stop talking about how much she loved her teacher already.

As a parent, I had been promised not just an excellent curriculum but also genuine care and attention to each child’s individual needs. On day one itself, I could feel those promises taking shape. In a world full of choices and competition, I feel confident that we made the right one.

Looking forward to this journey with Billabong High, Malad – with gratitude and excitement.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Tanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
I studied at Billabong High International School from Junior KG to Grade 10, and it was an incredible journey from start to finish. The environment was warm, welcoming, and always supportive—from the amazing teachers who genuinely cared about our growth, to the joyful memories of playing on the jungle gym in the early years.

What truly sets Billabong apart is how it nurtures every aspect of a student’s development. It’s the place where I discovered and honed many of my core skills—public speaking, leadership, dance, martial arts, and most importantly, empathy. The school never focused only on academics; it focused on shaping well-rounded individuals.

Billabong played a huge role in who I am today. It gave me confidence, discipline, and the space to grow. I’m genuinely grateful for everything this school has given me. Highly recommended for any parent looking for a place where their child can truly thrive—both in learning and in life.

PATHETIC MANAGEMENT
I’m not upset about the admission decision — schools have their own criteria, and that’s understandable. What is completely unacceptable, however, is the utter lack of response despite repeated follow-ups.
After making multiple attempts to get a simple update, I was met with silence. No acknowledgment, no clarity, nothing. For an institution that claims professionalism, this level of disregard for parents’ time and effort is extremely disappointing.
Basic courtesy isn’t too much to expect — even a straightforward rejection would have been appreciated. Ignoring parents after they’ve invested time, effort, and hope reflects very poorly on your system.
I strongly urge the management to address this gap in communication. Parents deserve respect, transparency, and timely responses — not silence.

featured_reviews.name: shefali garg
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing and unprofessional experience with Vibgyor School. I called for a simple query and was met with a shocking level of arrogance and rudeness. The staff disconnected my call twice, and on the third attempt, I was spoken to in a disrespectful, condescending tone. One of the staff members even had the audacity to say,
“You might have wasted time, not us,” and added, We are big enough across the country, one customer less won't matter.

Worse still, the lady on the call kept lying, insisting that we had already spoken before — even though it was my very first call. Instead of helping, she kept pushing me away and speaking rudely to my team.

As a professional and as someone who respects the power of education, I find this behavior unacceptable. Schools are meant to model values like humility, honesty, and respect—not arrogance, dishonesty, and disregard for others' time.

I urge parents, Don’t go by the brand name alone. Test how the staff communicates with you. Ask questions. Observe how they treat people who are not yet enrolled.
That’s the real reflection of the school’s values.

Totally disillusioned. A school may have infrastructure and branches, but without basic courtesy and ethics, it’s failing at its core purpose.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nostalgia to school days!
St Anne's High School is located in Orlem, Malad (West). They have a computer lab, science laboratory, AV room, library, a big hall and spacious classrooms. One major plus point is that it has a ground of its own. There are many extracurricular activities, inter school competitions, etc which one can be part of during their school days. Overall it's a good school. Most of the teachers are well qualified and know how to make the students understand the things taught. However at times, some teachers behave very abruptly with students, they're always frustrated and have anger issues. There's a difference between being strict and being a good teacher. Some teachers are also partial towards students due to which equal opportunity is not given to all and only their favoured students are seen everywhere, be it academic or non academic related things or competitions. For some reason, the non-teaching staff is always irritated.

The students of Form 5B of Shri Balaji International School, Malad, conducted a special assembly on World Environment Day on 15th June 2026. The assembly began with a prayer and prayer song that enlightened the mind and soul. Students presented speeches in English and poems in Marathi and English, emphasizing the importance of protecting the environment. The Thought of the Day highlighted the impact of human greed on nature, while young reporters shared international, national, sports, and school news.

The dynamic Principal, Dr. Pooja Shringarpure, addressed the students and encouraged them to protect the environment through simple actions in their daily lives. She stressed that small steps taken consistently can make a significant difference in preserving our planet. The assembly served as a timely reminder of the urgent need to safeguard Earth from further harm.

The first day of the new academic session was conducted with great enthusiasm and positivity at our school. The morning assembly was held in the school premises, marking a fresh beginning for both students and teachers.✨💫

A Day of Inspiration, Learning & Togetherness✨💫

Teachers Orientation Session at Shri Balaji International School was truly a memorable and enriching experience.
The session brought together meaningful discussions, engaging activities, shared learning, and moments of genuine camaraderie among our faculty members.

More than just an orientation, it was a beautiful reminder of the values that guide us every day - dedication, responsibility and teamwork.

Here's a glimpse into a day filled with positivity, purpose, and preparation for a successful academic year ahead.

✨ When learning feels like laughter, you know something magical has happened ✨

Had the absolute pleasure of conducting an orientation session with the wonderful teachers of Balaji International School, Malad. What was planned as a 2-hour workshop effortlessly turned into 3 hours of energy, interaction, and meaningful conversations- and we didn’t even realise how time flew!

From mastering communication with parents, students, and colleagues… to understanding the art of time management and creating a healthy work-life balance, this session was all about real, practical tools for real classroom challenges.

What made it truly special was the incredible participation and openness of the teachers. Their enthusiasm, honesty, and willingness to engage made the entire experience so enriching.

Grateful to have shared the “Smart Teacher Blueprint” with them- a small takeaway, but hopefully a powerful reminder of everything we explored together.

Here’s to classrooms filled with clarity, staffrooms filled with collaboration, and teachers who thrive both professionally and personally ❤️

Thank you GETA Examiner Ms @leeanamaryc for this wonderful opportunity🌻
